name: The Horned King's Offer
summary: A black goat with three red eyes walks the wood and tempts. His final offer to each hero is their heart's desire, a Dark Bargain with only the features they choose, and a level. He will attack anyway.

stages.journal: The Horned King has spoken to us in the dark.
stages.hint: Keep going north, and keep your wits.

stages.journal: He made each of us his offer, with the price left unsaid.
stages.hint: Accept or refuse, hero by hero.

stages.journal: We refused him, each of us.
Some of us took his bargain.
All of us took his bargain, and we knelt.
